prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic boutique fitting-room fashion portrait with a burgundy ribbed top, grey jeans and a softly sunlit retail environment.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with light blue-green eyes, natural makeup, long straight chestnut-brown hair with soft highlights, realistic pores and subtle freckles. She wears a fitted burgundy ribbed long-sleeve crop top with shoulder cut-outs and a long integrated choker ribbon, paired with high-waisted dark-grey jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 portrait of the adult subject seated or supported casually in the fitting-room area, one hand holding the burgundy ribbon near her shoulder while the other rests naturally. Keep her calm direct gaze and relaxed fashion posture. Include clothing racks, a cream sleeveless garment on display, mirror edges, curtain and boutique floor.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight enters from the fitting-room side and mixes with gentle indoor fill, producing realistic highlights and mild floor shadows. Keep the atmosphere clean, modern, editorial and approachable.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 vertical portrait, 50–85mm equivalent lens, sharp face and knit detail, moderate background falloff, natural skin texture, realistic denim and boutique materials, restrained filmic color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic boutique fitting-room fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman with light blue-green eyes, natural makeup, long straight chestnut-brown hair with soft highlights, realistic pores and subtle freckles.
